Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
this is a transcript of the 2013 EC day 2 final. It's not exhaustive as I didn't get the chance to see for instance what were all the discards, even missed here and there some cards played, but it should give a feel of the EC final. Thanks to Isak, Randy, Adam and all the organizing crew for hosting us.

Turn 1

Martin xfer 1. discard govern.
Hugh xfer 1 and 1.
Ankha xfer 3. discard Swallowed by the Night
Otso wider view. Powerbase Montreal. Uses wider view, remove goratrix. Xfer3. 1 from montreal on someone else. Blythe is out. Discard govern.
Mock Parthenon- Otto drops beer. Fragment book of nod. Xfer 2 and 2 . Normal and Brasil out. Discard malk justicar.

Turn 2

Martin xfer 5. discard reins of power.
Hugh xfer 3 and 1. no discard
Ankha giotto verducci is out. Discard voter cap
Otso Blythe Magic of the Smith on Bowl of Convergence. Uses wider view, remove goratrix, xfer 3, 1 from montreal, Aisling is out, discard Villein. Mock uses fragment, disc
Mock 1h54 remaining. Madness network in play. Uses fragment. Pentex on Blythe. Watenda is influenced. Disc madness network

Turn 3

Martin no master, Brazil calls Malk justicar. Otso OtQV Blythe. Aisling plays My Enemy's Enemy , blocks, hand strike. Normal calls Malk justicar, Hugh plays DI. Normal bleeds for 1, gets edge, Watenda calls Reversal of Fortune. Martin discards political stranglehold, Hugh discard Anarchist uprising, vote fails. Ingrid Rossler is out.
Hugh Influence Lodin, disc conditioning. Giotto discard Lost in crowds
Ankha Monastery of Shadows, Giotto takes Montreal, not blocked,Giotto Freak Drives. Uses Montreal, xfers.
Otso Villein for 2 on Aisling. Aisling removes Pentex, not blocked. Blythe equips Heart of Nizchetus.
Giotto blocks with Sense the Sin, hands for 1. Aisling 2 blood, Giotto 5 blood. Uses Wider view, removes Goratrix. Xfers 3, Masika St John is out. Otso 22 pool
Mock Uses Fragment. Smiling Jack. Perfectionist on Watenda. Dollface is influenced. Mock 16 pool, disc reversal of fortunes

Turn 4 1h44 left

Martin Villein 7 on Ingrid. Secure Haven on Ingrid. Xfers 4.
Hugh plays Dreams. Sup Govern unblocked. Pays 1 to see 1. Joao Bile is out.
Ankha Villein 2, equips kaymakli fragment, not blocked, freak drive. Uses Fragment, not blocked.
Xfers, Arika is out. Ankha 15 pool. Disc Dreams
Otso Pentex on Arika. Masika steals Montreal, not blocked. Aisling equips .44 Magnum, not blocked. Passes impulse. Dollface attemps remove Pentex. Not blocked. Passes again. Watenda bleeds , not blocked. Passes. Mock passes. Xfers 4. Otso 14 pool.
Mock 1 on Smiling, gains 1 from Edge. Uses Fragment. Plays Barren. Pays 1 to see 1.

Turn 5 1h 37 left

Martin pays 1 pool for Smiling. Xfers. Stanislava out. Hugh taps Dreams ? For influence. Disc defelction. Martin 13 pool.
Hugh blood doll on Joao. (pays smiling with Joao). Sup. Govern with Lodin. Uses Dreams for Influence. Joao equips with Ivory Bow. Pays 1 to see 1. Emily is out. Hugh 16 pool
Ankha pays smiling on Arika. Plays Ventrue HQ. Played skill Presence before on Giotto at some Point. Giotto uses Fragment, not blocked. Arika plays Political stranglehold, Blyth attemps to block, stealth from Monastery. Passes in spite of vote discard from Mock against and Hugh against. Ankha 19 pool. Martin 19 pool. Hugh 19 pool. Xfers x. Ankha 16 pool
Otso pays Smiling on Aisling. Pays 1 pool to Arika. Giants Blood on Aisling. Passes. Watenda bleeds. Stanislava deflects on Hugh. Hugh loses 1 pool. Otso passes, Mock passes. Goratrix is out.
Otso 9 pool. Disc Rego Motus
Mock 2 on Smiling. Uses Fragment. , disc sargon fragm, reversal. Uses Barrens, disc
Reinforcments. Xfers, Zoe is out.

Turn 6 1h27 left

Martin pays Smiling with Stanislava. Contests Dreams. Ingrid burns Network, attempt to block, Rapid Change, Network burned. Stanis sup Govern, no block. Xfers 1. Martin 17 pool
Hugh pays smiling with lodin and emily. Lodin sup Govern. Stanis Sense the Savage way to untap. Action not blocked. Julio bleeds for 1, no block. Xfer. Graham prince of Miami is out. Dics Stick. Hugh 14 pool.
Ankha pays Smiling with Arika and 1 pool ? Plays Wider View, plays Ashur Tablet. Giotto Kaymakli action, no block. Uses wider view 2 times, removes 2 giotto. Xfers Jaroslvav Pascek is out. Ankha 12 pool.
Otso burns Montreal to Arika, pays smiling with masika and goratrix. Goratrix employs Mr Winthrop, no block. Masika hunts, no block. Pays 1 to see 1. discards Ivory Bow
Mock uses Fragment and Barrens. 3 on smiling, plays network

Turn 7 1h18 left

Martin pays smiling with stanis i guess. Pays contest. Ingrid hunts, no block. Stanis sup Govern. Graham 2nd Trad. Blocked, Stanis Earth Meld. Stanis burns Smiling, attemps to block, Earth Control, Smiling is burned. Retro influences. Martin 20 pool.
Hugh pays contest with Edge. Gets pool from blood doll. Julio bleeds for 1, not blocked. Lodin bleeds for 1, Arika blocks. Hands for 1. Lodin Hidden Strength, presses. 2Nd round Arika Swallowed to go to long. Hugh presses with Indomitability, 3rd round Arika sup. Majesty. Arika 5 blood. Disc smthng
Ankha pays for infernal. Ankha 10 pool. Giotto calls Reins of power after discussion with Martin. Goratrix sup Eyes of Argus, monastery, sense savage way, swallowed night, read the winds, lost in crowds, DI, sup elder imp. No blocks. Ankha 8 votes in favor. Martin OK if Ankha ok with Martin next vote, Ankha agrees. Ankha 8 pool, Otso 2 pool, Mock 7 pool, Martin 22 pool, Hugh 10 pool.
Giotto voter caps. Ankha 10 pool, Giotto 7 blood. I guess Freaks Drive before Voter cap. Passes. Gains 2 pool from Wider View. Disc Montreal.
Otso Goratrix equips with Bowl. Pascek blocks, combat, pascek sup Majesty. Passes. Brazil bleeds for 1 requests just for Edge. Stanis blocks, hands for 1, Stanis rolling with the Punches. Otso passes impulse. Normal equips Flamethrower, no block after Mock asks if he can euip flamethrower at 3 pool. Otso passes. Mock passes. Gains 2 pool from Wider View. Disc enkil cog
Mock uses barrens, plays Wider View. Asked if Martin allows him to survive. Brazil hunts, no block. Gains 2 from wider view, plays Anthelios.

Turn 8 1h03 left

Martin pays dreams contest. Xfers 4.
Hugh pays contest with Edge. Julio bleeds , no block, bonding, Ankha 10 pool. Emily bleeds. Arika blocks, hands for 1. Hugh 10 pool
Ankha Villein 5 on Pascek. Ankha 15 pool. Pentex on Goratrix.Giotto Unleash Hell Fury, no blocks. Giotto bleeds sup Legal Manipulations Masika attempts block. Monastery stealth, , no block, 3, Aisling tel Misdi on Mock. Mock 1 pool. Arika bleeds for 3 , Masika attempts to block, sup Faceless Night, Blyth attempts (has Bowl), Swallowed, Eyes of Argus inf, Foreshadowing destruction, blocked. Otso now full taped. Combat : hands for 1, Blyth prevents Rego Motus, Arika Fread Drive.
Arika 2 blood. Disc kaymakli. Ankha 11 pool
Otso plays Wider View. Blythe hunts (mandatory), Jaroslav blocks, hands for 1, Blythe in torpor. Aisling equips with Bowl, no block. Passes. Mock is at 1 pool negotiates bleed for 1 to pay for wider view, Stanis murmur of the false will on Ankha, no block. Passes. Watenda equips Flamethrower, not blocked. Burns wider view. Otso 5 pool.
Mock puts wider view in plays with Anthelios. Burns wider view, Mock 3 pool. Ankha uses Giotto disc

Turn 9 50 min left

Martin pays contest. Ingrid hunts, no block. Influences Etrius out. Ankha uses giotto disc. Martin 9 pool.
Hugh pays for contest. Joao burns pentex (has ivory bow). Ankha OtQV on Giotto, blocks, Giotto sup Majesty. Passes. End of turn. Hugh 9 pool
Ankha Ashur Tablet. Giotto inf Entrancement, no block after Monastery, My Enemy Enemy. Hugh deflects on Mock. No block. Mock 1 pool. Arika bleeds for 3, Masika attempts to block, block, hands for 1. Masika 0 blood, Arika 1 blood. Ankha passes impulse, Mock passes. Disc villein. Ankha 11 pool.
Otso Contests Pentex on Watenda. Masika Hunts, no block. Mock uses Fragment. Otso passes. Normal bleeds for 1, Stanis blocks, Earth Meld. Otso passes, Watenda bleeds for 1, passes. Martin 8 pool. Goratric bleeds for 2, Dollface blocks, Goratrix steals 2. Otso passes, Mock passes. Disc MotS. Otso 3 pool.
Mock gains 1 from Edge, plays Wider view via Anthelios. Gains 2, Mock 3 pool

Turn 10 38 min left

Martin Villein 7 on Etrius. Zillah Valley. Ingrid calls Parity Shift, Martin has 9 pool, no block. Ankha only legal target. Some discussion terms Ankha -5 Martin +4 Otso +1. Mock casts reversal of fortunes agains, Martin in favor, ankha against, Hugh in favor, if martin retro backs : vote passes by 1. Passes. Martin 13 pool, Ankha 6 pool, Otso 4 pool. Martin retro
Hugh pays contest dreams, Emily bleeds, Governm Daring. Otso says he has DI. OK to play DI if Ankha is ok to bleed so that Otso can tel misdi on Amkha. Otso plays DI. Combat, hands with pascek i think. Joao govern bleed, Unleash blocks, Joao torpor with 1 blood. Graham Govern, Ankha declines block, Goratrix Eyes of Argus, Eagle Sight, blocked, hands vs steal 2. Graham 4 blood, goratrix 9 blood. Lodin rescues Joao, 1 eachm no block. Disc ventrue HQ, Ankha uses giotto disc. Hugh 8 pool
Ankha yields contest of pentex. Plays 3rd Ashur tablet 27mn24s left. Once 13 cards retrieved, takes majesty in hand, 25mn 13sec left. Giotto Unleash Hell Fury, Goratrix sup Eyes of Argus ans sup Eagle sight. Block attempt. Stealth from Monastery, not blocked. Giotto plays Contagion. No block. Arika bleeds for 3. OtqV Masika block attempt, swallowed by the night, Aisling tel misdi on Mock. Mock dies, 21 mn left, disc deflection. Ankha 6 pool.
Otso Goratrix bleeds for 2, no block. Martin 14 pool. Disc blood doll.

Turn 11 19 mn left

Martin pays for contagion. Passes
Hugh plays Pentex on Jaroslav. Hugh has 3 pool. Ankha has 6 pool. Emily bleedsm no block, sup foreshadowing destruction. Joao bleeds, UHF blocks, Joao torpor. Lodin bleeds, no blocks, Murmur of false will. Ankha ousted , 17mn30 left. Disc carlton. Hugh 9 pool.
Otso Villein on Goratrix. Goratrix 3 blood, Otso 13 pool. Some disc about diablerie and if Martin ousts Hugh, Otso wins anyway. Blythe diablerizes without taking ivory bow,, not blocked, survives blood hunt. Goratrix bleeds govern, Etrius blocks, Goratrix steals 2.

Turn 12

Martin plays Monastery and pays contest of Dreams. Ingrid Parity shift, Lodin 2nd trad, Ingrid sup. Form of Mist, no block. Hugh loses 3. Hugh 6 pool. Martin 11 pool. Stanislva Govern, Emily attempts block, Forced March, Graham deflects. Goratrix eyes of argus+tel misdi back on hugh. Graham redirection on Otso. Goratrix blocks. Stanis Earth Meld. Etrius, 2 blood, Govern bleed, monastery stealth, 2nd trad on graham. Blocked. Graham weighted walking stick. Form of mist dodge, press indomitability, form of mist dodge again. 10Min left. Stanislava calls Anarchist Uprising. Graham 2nd trad, stanis Earth Control, no blocks. Passes. Martin 7 pool. Hugh 3 pool.
Otso 9 pool.
Hugh pays contest dreams. Discards vessel.
Otso Goratrix bleeds for 2. Stanis sense the savage way blocks. Goratrix steals 2. Stanis empty. Masika bleeds for 1.

Turn 13

Martin who had played Jake 1 or 2 turns before fills stanis. Villein for 2 on stanis. Pentex on Goratrix. Stanis bleeds for 3. Graham blocks. Blocked. Sup Form of Mist. Lodin deflect on Otso. Otso takes it. Otso 6 pool. Forced March on Stanis. Ingrid bleeds, Lodin attempts blocks, earth control, , murmyr of fqlse will, emily deflects on otso. Otso takes it, Otso 4 pool. Etrius bleeds, Lodin tries to block, rapid change stealth, Emily deflects, Aisling blocks, Aisling goes to long with .44, Etrius Earth Meld.
Hugh yields contest. Haven uncovered on Etrius. Emily hunts, no block. Graham goverm bleed, Aisling OtQV, blocked, maoeuver 44, unflinching, indomitability and hit stick, press, aisling torpor. Lodin bleeds, no blocks, conditioning, My ene,y enemy, Martin takes 4. Martin 2 pool.
Otso blood doll Aisling, puts 1 on aisling, maiska resuec and pays. Aisling tries to burn pentexm stanis blocks and earth meld. Martin gets Dreams back. Etrius bleeds for 3, Graham deflects, Otso is ousted. Less than 50secs left.

I didn't follow the last bit, so dunno if Hugh conceded or whatever. Congrats to him anyway ! and congrats to all the day 2 players, with special cheers to the finalists.

Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
Thanks. Since I wasn't used to the Mcintosh keyboard (no 'end' or 'home' or whatever keys) and lost habit of writing in qwerty, I was kinda struggling so left out some of the fluffy details. for instance :
-Ankha spelling out for me the name of Jaroslav when he came in the ready region
-in the end game, when Otso was telling Hugh that a bleed of 5 from his ventrue could be deflected to him and Hugh said something like 'yeah, so what's the problem ?'. Otso, with a smile : 'sure, a bleed for five, no problem. You convinced me'
-also in the end game-can't remember exactly when, but IIRC it was back when Otso had the lead with 1VP-Martin asked Hugh if he could deflect, Hugh said no. He deflected somewhat no so much later on, of course.
-Martin said somethin when Hugh deflected the last bleed, or the one before that. Can't remember exactly what, but it was said in half-amused, half-disappointed way and finished by "you bastard".
-and probably some others. but I can't look up for them since my baby son has been out of sight for more than a minute, so that's way past the time constant for trouble, i gotta investigate
What I personnally preferred is in the transcript, when Mock talked his way out of block attempt when equipping with the flamethrower.
